data.title: Why Is Crypto Going Down? Bitcoin Tests $80,000 as Ethereum, XRP and Dogecoin Sink to August Lows
data.description: Crypto fell after a tech selloff and $773.5M of ETF outflows. My charts show bitcoin on $80,000 with $75,055 next, and ether and XRP on their last supports.
